blocks.x: Cyber & Zero-Trust for Medical Devices & MedTech — zero-trust by architecture, not by slide — identity, detection, resilience and ai security in one program applied to the medical devices & medtech operating unit of Healthcare & Life Sciences.

MedTech sells outcomes and must prove them: connected devices generate telemetry that feeds service revenue, clinical evidence and regulatory post-market surveillance. The device-to-evidence loop is an engineering product — and EU MDR/CRA raise its bar.

items: EU CRA/MDR cybersecurity duties land on fleets with legacy firmware; SBOMs unknown.
Installed base lacks provisioning/OTA; service runs on reactive dispatch and field guesswork.

blocks.x: The pattern composes Zero-Trust Architecture & Implementation, AI Security & Model Protection, Cyber Resilience & Incident Recovery from the Cybersecurity & Zero-Trust tower, wired into the unit's workflows (Device provisioning/OTA, Service dispatch, Vigilance reporting) on Tele Medicine Platform and Driisti Smart Vision Glasses. Governance inherits the sector frame — EU MDR among others — with evidence generated by the delivery itself.

items: Evidence once, audit anywhere — compliance automation across SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, DORA and privacy.
Never trust, always verify — zero-trust as an executable architecture, not a slide.
Detection that keeps pace — intelligence-driven SOC with the boring parts (tuning, coverage) done properly.
SBOMs, signed firmware and vulnerability SLAs (CRA/MDR duties evidenced)
